summary: Parked-up Mitre Street kerb, level at the top end; homes within 25 m all round.

best_section.where: West kerb just south of the main road, beside the building site and solar-roofed block

drivers.seclusion: Building site 6 m away (non-residential); La Fayette apartments 18 m on the same side; retail and apartments 18-21 m opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Public street with a parking lane where cars park; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street, close to a main road at the top end.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but 1P and 2P resident-permit signs apply on weekdays.

flags: Homes within about 25 m all round
Main-road noise near the top end
sun_shade: Open at the best section; building to the west shades the kerb in the afternoon.
